extracted.name: Chicken & Bacon Pizza
extracted.description: #12plates I use the same pizza dough recipe of Pepperoni Pizza (recipe link below).
ingredient_lines: Salt and ground pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt the butter in a small sauce pan.
Stir in the flour and cook, stirring constantly, until the paste cooks and bubbles a bit, but don't let it brown.
Add the warm milk, continuing to stir as the sauce thickens. Bring it to a boil.
Add permesan, salt and pepper to taste, lower the heat, and cook, stirring for 1 to 2 minutes more.
Remove from the heat. To cool this sauce for later use, cover it with cling wrap of milk over it to prevent a skin from forming.
Lightly grease baking sheet or pizza pan with oil.
Place the dough on the prepared pan.
Stretch and flatten the dough into a circle or rectangle.
Spread the white sauce on the crust.
Cover the pizza while preheating the oven to 450°F.
Bake the pizza on the lowest rack for 10 minutes.
